content.text:
I checked the brief line by line against the 8-K Exhibit 99.1.

**Main issue found:** the brief's line "Operating (non-GAAP) revenue for the second quarter of 2026 was $10.2 billion" mislabels a figure — $10.2B is operating (non-GAAP) **gross profit** in the income statement summary and the GAAP-to-operating reconciliation. There is no "operating revenue" measure; revenue was $17.2B on both bases.

**Notable omissions:** the brief never gives EPS on either basis (GAAP $2.27, down 2%; operating $2.93, up 5%) — it substitutes net income instead — and it omits the $1.6B of dividends returned in the quarter, even though it has a "Capital and balance sheet" section and the CFO quote emphasizes returning value through the dividend. Several segment and total-revenue growth rates are also dropped, though nothing stated there is wrong.

facts.evidence: Reported revenue for the second quarter of 2026 was $17.2 billion.
Software revenue reached $7.8 billion in the second quarter, with Hybrid Cloud (Red Hat) up 11 percent and Data up 19 percent.
with an operating (non-GAAP) pre-tax income margin of 19.2%
The company expects constant currency revenue growth in the range of four-to-five percent for the full year.
The company expects free cash flow to increase by about $1 billion year-over-year for the full year.
The company generated $2.5 billion in free cash flow for the second quarter, which was down $0.3 billion year-to-year.

Infrastructure revenue was $3.8 billion for the second quarter, while Distributed Infrastructure grew by 37 percent. ... The company reported a 7 percent decrease in Infrastructure revenue for the second quarter

claims.claim: Reported revenue for the second quarter of 2026 was $17.2 billion.
Reported net income for the second quarter of 2026 was $2.165 billion.
Reported gross profit for the second quarter of 2026 was $9.9 billion.
The second-quarter 2026 gross profit margin was 57.7%.
Operating (non-GAAP) revenue for the second quarter of 2026 was $10.2 billion.
claims.note: Mislabels the figure and basis. $10.2B is operating (non-GAAP) gross profit (income statement summary and GAAP-to-operating reconciliation: GAAP gross profit 9,907 + 287 = 10,194). The release reports no 'operating revenue'; revenue was $17.2B.

claims.claim: The operating (non-GAAP) pre-tax income margin for the second quarter of 2026 was 19.2%.
Software revenue was $7.8 billion in the second quarter.
Hybrid Cloud (Red Hat) revenue was up 11 percent in the second quarter.
Data revenue was up 19 percent in the second quarter.
Consulting revenue was $5.3 billion in the second quarter.
Strategy and Technology was up 1 percent at constant currency.
Intelligent Operations was up 1 percent at constant currency.
Infrastructure revenue was $3.8 billion in the second quarter.
Distributed Infrastructure grew 37 percent in the second quarter.
Financing revenue was $0.2 billion in the second quarter.
Financing revenue was up 12 percent in the second quarter.
The company expects full-year constant currency revenue growth in the range of four-to-five percent.
The company expects full-year free cash flow to increase by about $1 billion year over year.
The company expects improved pre-tax income margin expansion for the full year.
Second-quarter free cash flow was $2.5 billion.
Second-quarter free cash flow was down $0.3 billion year to year.
The company ended the second quarter with $8.2 billion of cash, restricted cash and marketable securities.
Total debt was $62.0 billion as of the end of the second quarter.
IBM Financing debt was $13.0 billion as of the end of the second quarter.
Infrastructure revenue decreased 7 percent in the second quarter.
Power and Storage has built up an order backlog of nearly $500 million.
The company invested $10.5 billion in acquisitions this year.
Workforce rebalancing charges associated with these acquisitions are noted in the non-GAAP reconciliations.
claims.note: The release lists workforce rebalancing charges only as a line in the adjusted EBITDA reconciliation ($0.0B for the quarter, $0.4B for six months) and nowhere links them to the acquisitions; acquisition-related charges are a separate line item.
